description: Free. One ticker's crowd (Nov 3): most pump.fun launches reuse a ticker (88.3% in October 2026), so before buying a coin, see every coin with its ticker. Its launches over the last three days by UTC day, each day's first launch and the coins that graduated (with how long after the first they launched), how many launched in the last two hours, its launches and deployers over 14 days, and every coin with the ticker that ever graduated, the first and the biggest named. For: how many $KIMCHI launched today, did the first one or a later one run, is this a rerun.
name: ticker_crowd
